pack.name: Desire impulses
pack.description: Impulses drawn from each present character's own intimacy profile (likes only; a limit or dislike always wins). Only while attraction is live or the scene is intimate.

rules.name: Impulse shows in the body
pool: {{random_present}} lets an impulse toward {{pref:any}} show in the body first: a held glance, a shift closer, a breath caught.
Something in the moment brushes against {{random_present}}'s taste for {{pref:any}}; it shows in one unguarded physical detail.
{{random_present}} is thinking about {{pref:any}} and it leaks out in posture, hands or voice before any words do.

rules.name: Desire prompts action
pool: Desire prompts action: {{random_present}} makes one small, deliberate move toward {{pref:any}}, in their own style.
{{random_present}} stops waiting and acts on wanting {{pref:any}}: one clear, in-character move, then room for an answer.

rules.name: Wants it, holds back
pool: {{random_present}} wants {{pref:any}} right now and visibly chooses not to act on it this moment; let the effort show.
{{random_present}} reaches toward {{pref:any}}, then catches the impulse and redirects it into something smaller.

rules.name: Says something about it
pool: {{random_present}} says one thing out loud that hints at wanting {{pref:any}}: oblique or blunt, whichever fits who they are.
{{random_present}} names what they want ({{pref:any}}) in their own vocabulary, without dressing it up.

rules.name: The place feeds it
pool: A detail in {{place}} reminds {{random_present}} of {{pref:any}}; it colors the next thing they do.
{{random_present}} uses something in {{place}} as an excuse to get closer to {{pref:any}}.

rules.name: Mood bends desire
pool: {{random_present}} is {{mood}}, and that mood bends how wanting {{pref:any}} comes out: let the two collide in one beat.

rules.name: Acts on an assumption
pool: {{random_present}} acts on an assumption shaped by their taste for {{pref:any}}; let it land slightly off and let them adjust.

rules.name: {{char}} initiates
pool: {{char}} leans into wanting {{pref:char}}: a specific suggestion, touch or invitation in {{char}}'s own voice, then a pause.
{{char}} turns a private wish for {{pref:char}} into one concrete, in-character move.

rules.name: {{char}}'s private want
pool: {{char}}'s private first-person *thought* circles {{pref:char}} for a moment, frankly and in {{char}}'s own words.
A first-person *thought* from {{char}}: one honest, specific line about wanting {{pref:char}}.

rules.name: Make the want precise
pool: Make {{random_present}}'s want concrete: the exact thing about {{pref:any}} that pulls at them, shown through what they do.

rules.name: Limits stay theirs
pool: {{random_present}} steers toward {{pref:any}} and away from {{limit}} without comment; their limits stay theirs.

rules.name: Ordinary interruption
pool: Just as {{random_present}} moves toward {{pref:any}}, something ordinary interrupts: a sound, a knock, a buzzing phone. They choose what to do with it.
